name: snapcanvas
description: Chrome extension (MV3) for capturing and annotating screenshots — full page, visible area, selected area, element capture with lossless PNG.
author: SnapCanvas Contributors

scripts.check: npm run lint && npx prettier --check "**/*.{js,css,html,json,yml}" && npm test
scripts.validate: node --check background.js && node --check editor.js && node --check popup.js && npm test
